Our values

This is the heart of the ControlMonkey culture. Our beliefs are the driving force that build our product and shape our relationships with our customers, partners and most importantly, with each other.

  • Customer Obsession

    We start from our customers and work backwards. We work vigorously to earn and keep our customers trust

  • Honesty

    We believe that honesty, truth, and mutual respect are the foundations of trust within our team

  • Ownership

    We act on behalf of the entire company, beyond just our own team. We never say “that’s not my job”

  • Insist on the Highest Standards

    We set the highest standards and we live by them every day

  • Deliver Results

    We value a can-do approach, spiced with an optimistic mindset, recognizing that our speed of delivery directly impacts business outcomes

Not finding a position that fits your skills?

If you’re looking to skyrocket your career and further develop yourself, professionally and personally, and work with the most talented individuals, then your place is with us!
